$comment: Baseline of QUEUED, human-owned design-token contrast issues. audit-checks classifies each color-contrast violation against these signatures: a match is tagged `queued` (already logged for a foundation decision — do NOT re-verify per component), anything else is a NEW finding that needs review. Match is by foreground hex (and background hex when given), case-insensitive. See the audit PRs that queued these.
